entries.rationale: जिंकण्याची शक्यता is natural Marathi and exactly matches the approved existing [Win chance] translation. Short enough for the percentage-axis title; no formatting tokens to integrate.

entries.source: Estimated chance of your alliance winning, sampled throughout the match. Allies share one probability. This model was trained on AI games; estimates do not account for position or planned moves. Older saves may have incomplete history.
entries.google_draft: तुमच्या गटाच्या जिंकण्याची अंदाजित शक्यता, जी संपूर्ण सामन्यादरम्यान तपासली जाते. सर्व गटांची संभाव्यता एकच असते. हे मॉडेल एआय (AI) खेळांवर प्रशिक्षित केले गेले आहे; या अंदाजांमध्ये स्थिती किंवा नियोजित चालींचा विचार केलेला नाही. जुन्या सेव्ह फाइल्समध्ये अपूर्ण इतिहास असू शकतो.
entries.proposal: तुमच्या युतीच्या जिंकण्याची अंदाजित शक्यता. सामनाभर तिची वेळोवेळी नोंद केली जाते. युतीतील सर्व मित्रपक्षांसाठी ही शक्यता समान असते. या मॉडेलला एआय सामन्यांवर प्रशिक्षण दिले आहे; या अंदाजांत नकाशावर कोण कुठे आहे किंवा कोणत्या चाली नियोजित आहेत याचा विचार केला जात नाही. जुन्या जतन केलेल्या खेळांचा इतिहास अपूर्ण असू शकतो.
rationale: Google says सर्व गटांची संभाव्यता एकच असते, falsely implying every opposing group has the same probability. Source/code/docs say members of one alliance share one prediction; different opponents have different estimates.
Use the established alliance term युती rather than generic गट, and explicitly restrict equality to allies in that alliance.
सामनाभर वेळोवेळी नोंद specifies stored temporal sampling instead of vague checking.

कोण कुठे आहे makes positional information explicit rather than confusing स्थिती with the overall game state that the numeric model actually does use. Preserve planned-move exclusion and AI-training limitation.
जुन्या जतन केलेल्या खेळांचा इतिहास अपूर्ण असू शकतो preserves uncertainty and partial history without claiming saved games are corrupt.

actual_source_context.actually_consulted_context: axisTitle appends (%) to [stat win probability]; about(metric) translates the metric help key.
Win-probability metric turns recorded permille samples into per-team percentage series; an actual0% value is valid data.

Allies are one competitor because they win/lose together. The model reads six numeric features; position, terrain, adjacency and future events are invisible. Old saves preserve only newly recorded probability history.
Alliance-wide 0–100% estimate recorded every512ticks; old saves have a gap before new samples start.

review_method: Actually read both exact upstream English values, both Google outputs, current approved Marathi alliance/win-chance terminology, source usages and model limitations. No other new review proposals read. No canonical catalog writes.
limits: Two-key linguistic/context review only; final editor/author wording still requires actual source-to-final rereads, token checks and affected rendering evidence. No full old-key reread is claimed.
